sections.Profile:
"El Toro," a pinball machine released by Bally in April 1972, is an electro-mechanical game designed by Jim Patla with artwork by Dick White. The machine is themed around bullfighting and features a single-player format with mechanical reels for scorekeeping. Its gameplay involves spelling out "EL TORO" by navigating the ball through top lanes, which then light up extra balls and special features.
